name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx for three virtual hosts, including static content, SSL site definitions, fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and sysctl security settings.

name: cache
description: Configures Memcached and Redis caching services, including Redis password authentication, Fedora-specific PID and log directories, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application with Python, PostgreSQL, a Git checkout, virtual environment, dependencies, database credentials, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
